text:
sam.chen: Quick sync — Q2 hosted API capacity planning. APAC region flagged: A100 supply lead times push to 8-12 weeks, cost team wants buy vs 6-month lease numbers by EOD. Can ops + infra weigh tradeoffs?

maya_g: short note — demand forecast bumped 18% vs plan after marketing campaign, tokens up. rough calc below.

maya_g: ```
scenario: base Q2 (no campaign) = 2.7e10 tokens
campaign uplift = +18% -> 3.186e10 tokens
avg_tokens_per_req = 350
p95_throughput_per_gpu = 230 tok/s
approx_gpu_hours = tokens / (throughput * 3600 * avg_tokens_per_req)
=> ~ (3.186e10)/(230*3600*350) ~ 5600 GPU-hours
```

tj: networking note — eu-west peering currently has transient errors during nightly KV-cache syncs, that increases tail latency. If we move more load to EU buy pool, need peering fix first or we risk elevated p99.

frank_k: cluster health comment — our hosted fleet has 7% spare capacity right now, usually we keep 15% buffer for rolling updates + zone failures. Buying reduces cost but ties capital; leasing gives buffer but higher unit cost. Also vendor A has slightly better QPS/kern for long sequences.

ana_platform: typo, meant ana_platform: ops ask — what if we mix: buy baseline for core EU/US demand, lease burst for APAC seasonality? That reduces commit and keeps fast scale up.

sam.chen: exactly — propose 3 scenarios for finance and infra: A) buy 30 A100s (cap floor), B) lease 60 for 6 months (burst heavy), C) hybrid buy20 + lease40. Need delta on cost, lead time, and risk (supply/peering/zone).

maya_g: quick cost sketch (rough):
- Buy 30: cap +30 GPUs, upfront $3.0M CAPEX (incl shipping + setup), lower TPV.
- Lease 60 (6mo): cap +60 GPUs, OPEX $0.9M over 6mo, faster start (~4 weeks).
- Hybrid: buy20 ($2.0M) + lease40 ($0.6M) -> balance.

frank_k: health/risk bullets:
- Buy: less vendor churn, but procurement lead time risk and no easy offload if demand drops.
- Lease: fast, flexible, but 10-15% higher unit cost and potential config drift in leased infra.
- Hybrid: operational complexity of two classes but best for p99 guardrails.

ops-bot: infra-alert: hosted-fleet-apac utilization=86% (1h avg), spare_buffer=7%, pod_evictions_last_24h=3, nightly-peering-failures=5

tj: action items: 1) eng-infra to produce runbook for hybrid operational handoffs (owner + rollback) 2) networking to schedule peering fix with cloud vendor (ETA 7 days) 3) finance to confirm budget envelope for hybrid by COB tomorrow.

sam.chen: +1. I'll assemble the decision doc with a recommended hybrid option and include the above numbers. if anyone has strong objections to buy/lease mix, call now. :thumbsup: :thinking_face:

maya_g: no objections from me, leaning hybrid.

frank_k: leaning hybrid too, but require auto-fallback policy: if nightly-peering-failures > 3 for 48h, shift APAC tail to US burst pool.

ana_platform: ops on it — will draft the fallback policy and owner list.

sam.chen: thanks — I'll send the deck to execs after we get finance numbers. Meeting to finalize tomorrow 10:00am PT.
